Before choosing a condition, separate restrictions on who or what the information concerns from restrictions on actions, properties and purpose. If the parent expressly restricts identity or consumer and the child's own meaning does not explicitly impose that restriction, test it first using someone or something outside it, preserving every child requirement. Apply the restriction to what it constrains and retain every permitted topic connection. If the child necessarily excludes the variation, identify the wording and explain why; the absence of an explicit matching restriction does not establish a counterexample.

Record one open-ended counterexample question per direction:
